description: Parent architecture spec §3 (line 112) hard-codes the absolute path '/Users/anicca/anicca/skills/_shared/proactive-loop.sh' in the ProgramArguments array. REQ-A2 (behavioral-spec.md:32-34) says 'the absolute path of skills/_shared/proactive-loop.sh' but never pins what 'absolute' resolves to: $HOME-relative? repo-root-relative? caller-cwd-relative? On a fresh checkout in ~/anicca-project/ vs ~/anicca/ the path differs. The spec is not 100% clear (CLAUDE.md 0.10) and the implementer will guess. Either pin the literal '/Users/anicca/anicca/skills/_shared/proactive-loop.sh' (matching parent §3) or define an unambiguous resolution rule (e.g. 'realpath of the script repo root + skills/_shared/proactive-loop.sh, with an explicit error if the resolved file does not exist').

evidence.snippet: ProgramArguments pointing to /bin/bash + the absolute path of skills/_shared/proactive-loop.sh + slot.
